topic: Mantis shrimp: throws one of the fastest punches in the animal kingdom, fast enough to crack shells, and has far more colour-sensing cells in its eyes than humans.

episode.title: Mantis Shrimp: A Blink-and-You-Miss-It Punch!

shots.narration: Did you know this tiny animal packs a shell-cracking punch?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated nature film style, underwater close-up inside a sunny rocky tide pool, a cute anatomically faithful mantis shrimp beside an empty seashell, no text.
shots.action: The mantis shrimp raises its folded striking appendages.
shots.mood: Sparkling turquoise water, warm sunlight, exciting anticipation.

shots.narration: Kiko and Pip discover a mantis shrimp in a tide pool.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny tropical tide pool, Kiko with brown skin, green safari hat, big binoculars and pocketed khaki vest, tiny emerald-green Pip with ruby-red throat hovering nearby, no text.
shots.action: Kiko points toward the mantis shrimp beneath the clear water.
shots.mood: Bright natural colours, friendly curiosity, peaceful shoreline.

shots.narration: [surprised] Wait! Its punch happened faster than Kiko could follow!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, split-level view of the clear tide pool, Kiko watching from the dry rock above, mantis shrimp underwater below, no text.
shots.action: The mantis shrimp snaps a striking appendage forward in a brief blur.
shots.mood: Sunny surprise, Kiko's wide eyes visible above the water.

shots.narration: Let's watch that again, slowed down!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cinematic underwater macro replay of the same mantis shrimp, detailed folded striking appendages, softly blurred rocks behind, no text.
shots.action: The mantis shrimp unfolds one striking appendage in slow motion.
shots.mood: Clear sunbeams, fascinating detail, a moment of discovery.

shots.narration: It's one of the fastest punches in the animal kingdom.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, underwater side view of the mantis shrimp facing a clearly empty seashell, its open hollow interior visible, no other animals, no text.
shots.action: The mantis shrimp punches the empty shell, cracking its rim.
shots.mood: Bright underwater light, impressive but gentle scientific observation.

shots.narration: [excited] That punch is fast enough to crack shells!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clear tide pool viewed from the rocky edge, cracked empty shell visible underwater, Kiko and Pip safely above the water, no text.
shots.action: Kiko lifts his binoculars for a closer look.
shots.mood: Delighted discovery, warm sunshine, shimmering water.

shots.narration: Its eyes have far more colour-sensing cell types than ours.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, realistic 3D macro close-up of the mantis shrimp's stalked eyes, naturally colourful shell and sunlit reef stones, no diagrams or text.
shots.action: The mantis shrimp swivels its stalked eyes.
shots.mood: Jewel-like natural colours, gentle wonder, crisp eye detail.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny tide pool with mantis shrimp visible below, Kiko crouched at a safe distance and emerald-green Pip beside his hat, no text.
shots.mood: Cheerful payoff, sparkling water, bright coastal scenery.

shots.narration: [whispers] Who can climb smooth walls? Guess our next animal!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, tropical shoreline beside a smooth sunlit rock face, Kiko in his green safari hat and khaki vest, Pip hovering nearby, no additional animals or text.
shots.action: Kiko points up the smooth rock face.
shots.mood: Playful mystery, golden sunshine, inviting adventure.

episode.endHook: Who can climb smooth walls? Guess our next animal!
episode.description: Kiko and Pip discover a mantis shrimp's astonishing punch in a sunny tide pool. Explore its shell-cracking power and remarkable colour-sensing eyes, then guess our next animal!
